RDKit bridge via reticulate

Source: R/dev_rdkit.R
dev_rdkit.Rd

Helpers for importing RDKit submodules and building molecules from SMILES. Import individual RDKit submodules by name (e.g. get_RDKit_Chem(), or reticulate::import("rdkit.Chem.Descriptors")) — do not use a single catch-all get_RDKit() for the whole package.

Details

Requires a Python environment with rdkit configured for reticulate. By default helpers select the conda env named env_for_r (override with option MSCC.rdkit.condaenv or argument condaenv). Call this before any other reticulate Python init in the session.
